Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This effect only allows you to place your [Erika Mishima] from the battle area in digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Start of Your Main Phase] effect to place [Erika Mishima] from the hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 of your [Erika Mishima] as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, this Digimon may digivolve into [Hudiemon] in the hand or trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] All of your Digimon with the [Hudie] trait get +1000 DP.
